description: This file contains functions related to handling legacy SD card upgrade processes, including checking image differences, performing upgrades, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the new image differs from the existing partition layout by comparing partition tables.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by writing the image to the appropriate device or partitions, depending on differences.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backups to the boot partition.
